## Teams, approvals, and reliable harness sessions

Nova Desktop 0.8.0 adds a dedicated Teams workspace, interactive harness adapters, observable Desktop tools, and turn-scoped read-aloud.

### Teams

- Open **Teams** from the sidebar to configure Nova, Nora, Serena, and Ralph, compose a task, and follow assignments, addressed messages, handoffs, and results.
- Nova can delegate bounded assignments, request follow-ups, message members, and inspect run status. The configured agent limit includes the coordinator.
- Investigation can overlap only through an adapter that enforces read-only access; Codex is the verified adapter in this release. Editing turns run exclusively.
- Cancel individual assignments or the whole run, explicitly retry failures, and recover interrupted runs after restarting without silently resuming work.

### Harnesses and approvals

- Keep Nova's pipe protocol; add Pi RPC, Claude bidirectional streaming, Codex app-server, and ACP sessions for OpenCode, Hermes, and supported CommandCode versions. Legacy CommandCode retains its mod permission bridge.
- A single **Auto-approve** toggle defaults to off and covers ordinary tool permissions and plans. Questions still require an answer; harness restrictions remain authoritative. Pending decisions retain their turn and teammate identity, can be retried after delivery failures, and resolve on cancellation.
- Existing `off` and `all` preferences migrate directly. Former `tools` preferences migrate to off with an explanation because the new toggle also approves plans.
- Reuse compatible sessions and prewarm the selected harness after workspace trust, without sending a model request. Unsupported interactive features report a specific limitation.

### Desktop tools, speech, and interface

- Scope tool credentials and calls to the active task, harness, workspace, team run, and member. Settings distinguishes configuration, discovery, successful calls, and failures, with durations and turn attribution.
- Show Desktop tool activity in the owning conversation. Fix Nova pipe MCP configuration and argument compatibility, CommandCode's Windows paths with spaces, and Hermes's slower session startup.
- Start read-aloud from complete final-answer sentences when the harness labels them; otherwise use its final reply at completion. Exclude previews, reasoning, tools, and internal team messages; deduplicate replacements.
- Add pause, resume, stop, per-reply playback, one-chunk synthesis prefetch, and cached local ONNX engines.
- Batch text rendering while delivering approvals and completion promptly. Preserve scroll position, respect reduced motion, and fix modal dismissal, focus return, and the Tools page opening its integrations sheet automatically.

### Updater repair

- Restore the original signing public key: one corrupted byte in the old configuration caused correctly signed installers to fail verification. This is a public-key correction, not a key rotation.
- Release builds now remain drafts until both MSI and NSIS signatures verify against the key shipped in the app.
- **Users of 0.7.0 and earlier should install 0.8.0 manually from the assets below.** Their embedded incorrect key cannot verify this update. Future releases can use the corrected in-app updater.

### Verification

- Local checks passed: frontend build and lint; Rust format and checks; 199 Rust library tests, 87 frontend tests, five MCP shim tests, and three Nova bootstrap tests. Strict Clippy and GitHub CI are release gates.
- Windows interaction checks exercised all 36 advertised MCP tools, pending approvals, cancellation, writer exclusion, scroll preservation, Teams, modal dismissal and focus, and reduced motion.
- A real Codex read-only turn attempted a file write: the OS denied it and no file was created. Read-only turns also reject project-check commands that would bypass the sandbox.

| Installed harness | Transport | Live Desktop create/rename checks | Cold / warm first visible text |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Nova 1.2.88 | Pipe | 4/4 passed | 30.7–80.9s / 16.7–27.1s |
| Pi 1.6.0 | RPC | 4/4 passed | 9.9–49.7s / 7.8–8.8s |
| Codex 0.172.0 | App-server | 4/4 passed | 7.6–10.5s / 2.4–2.6s |
| OpenCode 2.3.2 | ACP | 4/4 passed | 35.7–68.4s / 12.8–14.6s |
| CommandCode 1.93.4 | ACP | 4/4 passed, including saved local registration | 6.4–9.1s / 3.2–5.9s |
| Hermes 0.23.4 | ACP | 4/4 passed | 24.5–88.1s / 10.2–11.7s |
| Claude Code 2.1.310 | Bidirectional streaming | Handshake passed; expired OAuth blocked live tool calls | Not available |

These are two cold and two warm trials per passing harness, using the same prompt and its configured default model. Warm sessions eliminated protocol-readiness waits; provider and model latency varied substantially. They are observations, not a controlled claim of model speedup.

### Requirements and known limits

Windows 10/11 with WebView2, Python 3 on PATH for terminal sessions, and the selected agent CLI installed and authenticated. Installable voice models remain separate downloads.

Claude's live tool verification requires renewed sign-in. Final-answer sentence streaming is verified for Codex; other adapters use completion fallback. Hardware/model-dependent speech tests were skipped. Piper still starts a process per chunk, and already-running ONNX inference finishes before cancellation takes effect.
